text: The purpose of this report is to obtain approval for the designation of a one-way traffic lane, anytime, for the southerly eastbound lane on Eglinton Avenue West, between Commerce Boulevard and a point 30.5 metres west, in the eastbound right-turning direction, buses excepted. It is appropriate to install an exclusive eastbound right turn lane based on the existing lane configuration and our observations. Since the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates transit service on Eglinton Avenue West, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the designation of a one-way traffic lane, anytime, for the southerly eastbound lane on Eglinton Avenue West, between Commerce Boulevard and a point 30.5 metres west, in the eastbound right-turning direction, buses excepted.
